<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 167.9pt 0pt 167.85pt; text-align: center">AMENDMENT NO. 9
TO SCHEDULE 13D</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-indent: 0.75in; text-align: left; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">This Amendment No. 9 supplements
the information set forth in the Schedule 13D filed by 40 North Management LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, 40 North
Latitude Fund LP, a Delaware limited partnership, 40 North GP III LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, 40 North Latitude
Master Fund Ltd., a Cayman Islands exempted company incorporated with limited liability, David S. Winter, an American citizen,
and David J. Millstone, an American citizen, with the United States Securities and Exchange Commission (the &ldquo;<U>SEC</U>&rdquo;)
on May 7, 2018, as heretofore amended (the &ldquo;<U>Schedule 13D</U>&rdquo;), relating to Common Stock, par value $0.01 per share
(the &ldquo;<U>Shares</U>&rdquo;), of W.R. Grace &amp; Co., a Delaware corporation (the &ldquo;<U>Issuer</U>&rdquo;). All capitalized
terms contained herein but not otherwise defined shall have the meanings ascribed to such terms in the Schedule 13D.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-indent: 0.75in; text-align: left; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-indent: 0.75in; text-align: left; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">The information set forth
in response to each separate Item below shall be deemed to be a response to all Items where such information is relevant. The
Schedule 13D is hereby supplementally amended as follows:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; text-align: left">Item 2.</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Identity and
                                         Background.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-indent: 0.75in; text-align: left; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">This statement on Schedule
13D is filed on behalf of 40 North Management LLC, a Delaware limited liability company (&ldquo;<U>40 North Management</U>&rdquo;),
40 North Latitude Fund LP, a Delaware limited partnership (&ldquo;<U>40 North Latitude Feeder</U>&rdquo;), 40 North GP III LLC,
a Delaware limited liability company (&ldquo;<U>40 North GP III</U>&rdquo;), 40 North Latitude Master Fund Ltd., a Cayman Islands
exempted company incorporated with limited liability (&ldquo;<U>40 North Latitude Master</U>&rdquo;), David S. Winter, an American
citizen and David J. Millstone, an American citizen (all of the foregoing, collectively, the &ldquo;<U>Reporting Persons</U>&rdquo;).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-indent: 0.75in; text-align: left; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">This statement relates to Shares held by 40 North
Latitude Master.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-indent: 0.75in; text-align: left; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">The
principal business of each of 40 North Latitude Feeder and 40 North Latitude Master is the making of investments in securities
and other assets. The principal business of 40 North GP III is to serve as general partner of 40 North Latitude Feeder. 40 North
Management serves as principal investment manager to 40 North Latitude Feeder and 40 North Latitude Master. As such, 40 North
Management has been granted investment discretion over portfolio investments, including the Shares. David S. Winter and David
J. Millstone serve as the sole members and principals of each of 40 North Management and 40 North GP III, and as the sole directors
of 40 North Latitude Master. The principal business address of all of the Reporting Persons, is 9 West 57th Street, 47th Floor,
New York, New York 10019. A joint filing agreement of the Reporting Persons is attached hereto as <U>Exhibit 1</U>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-indent: 0.75in; text-align: left; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-indent: 0.75in; text-align: left; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"></P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 8 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&nbsp;</P></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 12pt"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&nbsp;</P></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-indent: 0.75in; text-align: left; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-indent: 0.75in; text-align: left; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">During the
last five years, none of the Reporting Persons has been convicted in a criminal proceeding (excluding traffic violations or similar
misdemeanors) or has been a party to a civil proceeding of a judicial or administrative body of competent jurisdiction and as
a result of such proceeding was or is subject to a judgment, decree or final order enjoining future violations of, or prohibiting
or mandating activities subject to, federal or state securities laws or finding any violation with respect to such laws.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; text-align: left">Item 3.</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Source and
                                         Amount of Funds or Other Consideration.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-indent: 0.75in; text-align: left; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">The responses to Items 4, 5 and 6 of this Schedule
13D are incorporated herein by reference.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-indent: 0.75in; text-align: left; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">The Shares reported herein
were purchased by 40 North Latitude Master using working capital. The total purchase price for the Shares reported herein was
$640,071,630. All or part of the Shares owned by the Reporting Persons may from time to time be pledged with one or more banking
institutions or brokerage firms as collateral for loans made by such bank(s) or brokerage firm(s) to the Reporting Persons. Such
indebtedness may be refinanced with other banks or broker dealers.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-indent: 0.75in; text-align: left; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">Item
4 of this Schedule 13D is hereby amended and supplemented by adding the following information:&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.75in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.75in">On March 31, 2021 at 11:59 p.m. ET, the standstill
provisions in the Confidentiality Letter Agreement, dated February 1, 2021, by and among the Issuer, 40 North Management, 40 North Latitude
Feeder, 40 North GP III and 40 North Latitude Master expired.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.75in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.75in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">As
previously disclosed, on January 11, 2021, 40 North Management delivered a letter to the board of directors of the Issuer (the &ldquo;<U>Board</U>&rdquo;)
(the &ldquo;<U>January Offer Letter</U>&rdquo;), pursuant to which 40&nbsp;North Management and its affiliated investment funds proposed
to acquire the Issuer for a price of $65.00 per Share in cash. On April 1, 2021, 40 North Management delivered another letter to the
Board (the &ldquo;<U>April Offer Letter</U>&rdquo;) pursuant to which 40 North Management and its affiliated investment funds offered
to acquire the Issuer for a price of $70 per Share in cash (the &ldquo;<U>Proposed Transaction</U>&rdquo;). The April Offer Letter supersedes
the January Offer Letter.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.75in"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.75in">The foregoing summary of
the Offer Letter is qualified in its entirety by reference to the full text of the Offer Letter, a copy of which is attached hereto as&nbsp;Exhibit
8 and is incorporated by reference herein. The Proposed Transaction may result in one or more of the actions specified in clauses (a)&minus;(j)
of Item 4 of Schedule 13D, including the acquisition or disposition of additional securities of the Issuer, a merger or other extraordinary
corporate transaction involving the Issuer, a change to the present Board of the Issuer, a change to the present capitalization or dividend
policy of the Issuer, the delisting of the Issuer&rsquo;s securities from the New York Stock Exchange, and a class of equity securities
of the Issuer becoming eligible for termination of registration pursuant to Section 12(g)(4) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.75in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.75in">There can be no assurance
as to the outcome of any discussions related to the Proposed Transaction or that the Proposed Transaction will be consummated.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.75in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.75in">(a)&nbsp; &ndash; (b) Each of 40 North
Management, 40 North Latitude Master, 40 North Latitude Feeder, 40 North GP III, Mr. Winter and Mr. Millstone may be deemed the
beneficial owner of all of the Shares reported herein, which represent approximately 14.9% of the Issuer&rsquo;s outstanding Shares.
40 North Management may be deemed to have sole power to vote and sole power to dispose of all of the Shares, whereas the other
Reporting Persons having beneficial ownership may be deemed to have shared power to vote and shared power to dispose of such Shares

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: right">Exhibit 1</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: center">AGREEMENT</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: center">JOINT FILING OF SCHEDULE
13D</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: left; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">The undersigned hereby
agree to jointly prepare and file with regulatory authorities this Schedule 13D and any future amendments thereto reporting each
of the undersigned&rsquo;s ownership of securities of W.R. Grace &amp; Co., and hereby affirm that such Schedule 13D is being
filed on behalf of each of the undersigned pursuant to and in accordance with the provisions of Rule 13d-1(k) under the Securities
Exchange Act of 1934. The undersigned acknowledge that each shall be responsible for the timely filing of such amendments, and
for the completeness and accuracy of the information concerning him or it contained therein, but shall not be responsible for
the completeness and accuracy of the information concerning the other, except to the extent that he or it knows or has reason
to believe that such information is inaccurate.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<DESCRIPTION>EXHIBIT 8
<TEXT>
<HTML>
<HEAD>
     <TITLE></TITLE>
</HEAD>
<BODY STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center; color: rgb(68,68,68)"><FONT STYLE="color: Black">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: right">Exhibit 8</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: left"><IMG SRC="image_001.jpg" ALT="40 North Ventures ??? Medium" STYLE="height: 45px; width: 95px"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center; color: rgb(68,68,68)"><FONT STYLE="color: Black">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 14pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center; color: #444444"><FONT STYLE="color: Black"><B>40
North Increases Offer for W.R. Grace to&nbsp;$70 Per Share</B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center; color: #444444"><FONT STYLE="color: Black"><B>&nbsp;</B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><FONT STYLE="color: Black"><I>Offer Provides Immediate
Cash to Grace Shareholders at a 74% Premium</I></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><FONT STYLE="color: Black">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; background-color: #FEFEFE; color: #444444"><FONT STYLE="color: Black">NEW
YORK -- 40 North Management LLC (&ldquo;40 North&rdquo;) today sent a letter to the Board of Directors of W.R. Grace &amp; Co (NYSE:
GRA) (&ldquo;Grace&rdquo; or the &ldquo;Company&rdquo;) increasing its offer to acquire all of the outstanding shares of common stock
for $70 per share in cash. The new offer represents a 74% premium over Grace&rsquo;s closing share price on October 13, 2020, the day
prior to 40 North filing a Schedule 13D/A with the Securities and Exchange Commission disclosing the resignation of the 40 North representative
from the Grace Board of Directors.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; background-color: #FEFEFE; color: #444444"><FONT STYLE="color: Black">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; background-color: #FEFEFE; color: #444444"><FONT STYLE="color: Black">In the letter, 40 North noted that beginning on February 1, 2021, it conducted a customary due diligence review of Grace in as comprehensive
a way as possible given the limitations of the information provided by the Company. Following the review, 40 North determined that its
proposal for $70 per share in cash fully values the Company and accordingly represents 40 North's best and final offer.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; background-color: #FEFEFE; color: #7AA52A"><FONT STYLE="color: Black">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; background-color: #FEFEFE; color: #444444"><FONT STYLE="color: Black"><B>The
full text of the letter follows:</B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; background-color: #FEFEFE; color: #444444"><FONT STYLE="color: Black">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; background-color: #FEFEFE; color: #444444"><FONT STYLE="color: Black">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; background-color: #FEFEFE"><FONT STYLE="color: Black">April 1, 2021</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; background-color: #FEFEFE"><FONT STYLE="color: Black">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; background-color: #FEFEFE"><FONT STYLE="color: Black">Board of Directors</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; background-color: #FEFEFE"><FONT STYLE="color: Black">W.R. Grace &amp;
Co.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; background-color: #FEFEFE"><FONT STYLE="color: Black">7500 Grace Drive</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; background-color: #FEFEFE"><FONT STYLE="color: Black">Columbia, MD
21044</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; background-color: #FEFEFE"><FONT STYLE="color: Black">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="color: Black">Dear Members of the
Board:</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="color: Black">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="color: Black">As you know, since
February 1, 2021 we have worked expeditiously to conduct a customary due diligence review of W.R. Grace &amp; Co. (&ldquo;Grace&rdquo;
or the &ldquo;Company&rdquo;) in as comprehensive a way as possible given the limitations of the information provided by the Company.
In connection with our review, we engaged numerous advisers, consultants and specialists to further our analysis of the various facets
of Grace&rsquo;s business. Though the results of our work did not fully support management&rsquo;s optimistic growth expectations for
Grace&rsquo;s specialty catalysts business, and we continue to have serious reservations with regard to the Company&rsquo;s questionably-timed
acquisition of Albemarle&rsquo;s Fine Chemistry Services business, we remain firm in our belief that Grace&rsquo;s full potential for
all stakeholders can best be achieved outside of the public markets with proactive, hands-on management. In this regard, we are prepared
to submit our best and final offer of $70 per share in cash (our &ldquo;Proposal&rdquo;). This Proposal represents a full valuation for
the Company and reflects a multiple of 11.9x consensus 2021E EBITDA and a 74% premium over the Company&rsquo;s unaffected share price<SUP>1</SUP>.
Moreover, it offers shareholders the opportunity to realize immediate, certain and attractive value.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="color: Black">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="color: Black">As stated previously,
our Proposal does not include any financing contingency, and our financing banks are Citi, J.P. Morgan, Deutsche Bank and BNP Paribas.
This Proposal is subject only to confirmatory diligence, which we expect to be able to complete in two weeks, and the execution of definitive
documentation. Our offer does not require any internal corporate or shareholder approvals and, with Grace&rsquo;s cooperation, we are
confident we can receive all necessary regulatory approvals in a timely manner.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="color: Black">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"></P>

<!-- Field: Rule-Page --><DIV STYLE="margin-top: 3pt; margin-bottom: 3pt; width: 25%"><DIV STYLE="font-size: 1pt; border-top: Black 1pt solid"><FONT STYLE="color: Black">&nbsp;</FONT></DIV></DIV><!-- Field: /Rule-Page -->

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">
<TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 9pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; color: Black"><SUP>1</SUP></FONT></TD><TD><FONT STYLE="color: Black">Prior
                                            to October 14, 2020, when 40 North filed its Schedule 13D amendment.</FONT></TD></TR>
</TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="color: Black">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"></P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 1 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&nbsp;</P></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 12pt"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&nbsp;</P></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="color: Black">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="color: Black">We stand ready to
engage with you and your advisers to deliver a transaction in the best interests of all Grace shareholders without delay and look forward
to hearing from you.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="color: Black">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="color: Black">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="color: Black">Sincerely,</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="color: Black">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">

                                            David S. Winter</FONT></TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="color: Black">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; background-color: #FEFEFE; color: #444444"><FONT STYLE="color: Black"><B>About
40 North:</B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; background-color: #FEFEFE; color: #444444"><FONT STYLE="color: Black">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; background-color: #FEFEFE; color: #444444"><FONT STYLE="color: Black">40
North is a fundamentally-based investment platform focused on public equities that takes concentrated, long-term positions across a range
of sectors and leverages deep industrial knowledge to create value for all stakeholders.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; color: #444444"><FONT STYLE="color: Black"><SUP>&nbsp;</SUP></FONT></P>
